overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused and highly engaged professional presence across LinkedIn, BlueSky, and Mastodon, with a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content predominantly revolves around computational social science, disinformation research, academic hiring, and tool updates (such as CooRnet). While LinkedIn holds his largest raw audience, BlueSky exhibits the highest engagement rate driven by community reposts and discussion surrounding new research and academic opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, publications, and conference presentations regarding coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Announcements for research grants, hiring postdoctoral researchers, and recruiting PhD students.
Updates on research software releases like CooRnet v2.0 and discussions on computational methods.

recommendations: Cross-promote high-performing research announcements across all platforms to maximize reach given differing platform demographics.
Leverage call-to-actions on LinkedIn posts to drive comment interaction, matching the high amplification seen on BlueSky.
Maintain consistent posting schedules across Mastodon to grow its engagement rate closer to BlueSky levels.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest overall engagement rate (~6.14%) with notable strength in reposts/amplification for publications and student recruitment opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a dedicated niche audience interested in technical tool updates like CooRnet and methodology, yielding moderate engagement (~4.55%).
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850) generating the highest absolute volume of likes and comments, particularly around major career achievements like research grants and job postings.
